updated.company: CALGARY RADIOPHARMACEUTICAL CENTRE / ALBERTA HEALTH SERVICES

changes.from:
Drug shortage due to a shortage of tin chloride, a critical component of the cold kit. Sent notification to drug shortage team on 31 Jul 2026, before account was set up. Mitigations: We have implemented conservation measures and have requested sites to split doses where clinically appropriate to reduce product use and extend available inventory. We have also directed our customers toward alternative products.


Additional measures are being evaluated to minimize impact on patient care, including:
Accelerated and conventional validation of alternative supplier (in progress).
Pursuing importation of equivalent kits via the "Exceptional Importation and Sale of Drugs in Response to Drug Shortages" (GUI-0148).
